user_motivation: Published ML rankings confound model quality with unequal human research and recipe effort. autoMIL provides an auditable research-operations substrate for matched autonomous source-level optimization, and autobench uses it to measure whether pathology-MIL rankings remain stable under equal declared research effort.
special_requirements: Use the bundled NeurIPS 2026 LaTeX template in NeurIPS26_autoMIL and preserve its formatting contract.
Compile main.tex locally to a viewable PDF and validate the rendered pages.
Write in English, keep all incomplete campaign results explicitly result-neutral, and never fabricate metrics, significance, or final rankings.
